text: Automatically detects JS errors in browser, Node.js, React Native, with framework plugins (React, Vue, Angular, Express, Restify, Koa)
quote: Automatically detect JavaScript errors in the browser, Node.js and React Native, with plugins for React, Vue, Angular, Express, Restify and Koa.

text: Lets developers manually report handled exceptions via a notify() SDK call
quote: Report handled exceptions using Bugsnag.notify()

text: Groups events into one issue based on error class, file, and line of the top in-project stack frame
quote: Grouped with other events sharing the same error class, file and line number of the top in-project stack frame of the innermost exception.

text: Lets users create rules to automate error handling workflows
quote: BugSnag allows you to create rules to automate this process.

text: Provides a view of all errors introduced in the last 24 hours
quote: All errors introduced in the last 24 hours

text: Lets you filter the dashboard by release to see which release introduced an error
quote: filter your dashboard by release and identify which release errors were introduced in.

text: Monitors application stability and lets you track progress against stability targets
quote: Monitor the stability of your application and measure progress against stability targets.

text: Provides tools to redact or remove sensitive data retroactively for GDPR/CCPA/HIPAA compliance
quote: BugSnag provides a set of tools that allow customers to redact or remove sensitive data retroactively, helping ensure continued compliance with internal policies and data protection regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA.

text: Sends alerts to Slack, Microsoft Teams, or other chat tools
quote: Get alerts in Slack, Microsoft Teams, or your team's communication tool.

text: Slack integration lets you act on errors directly from Slack channels
quote: The Slack integration can send notifications to any Slack channel and allows you to take action on errors straight from Slack.

text: PagerDuty integration automatically creates incidents from error activity
quote: The PagerDuty integration creates incidents in PagerDuty when error activity is reported to BugSnag.

text: Webhook plugin delivers error and project data as soon as events are processed
quote: The webhook plugin allows access to error and project data as soon as they are received and processed by BugSnag.

text: Supports JavaScript source maps to unminify production stack traces
quote: The BugSnag error monitoring SDK supports using source maps to reverse JavaScript transformations.

text: Lets you create a build record to enrich release information shown in the dashboard
quote: Allows you to create a build within BugSnag to enrich releases shown in the BugSnag dashboard.

text: Offers a self-hosted on-premise version for organizations that must control their own data
quote: BugSnag On-premise offers a self-hosted version of BugSnag for organizations that need or want to manage their own data. It can be run in your existing PCI or HIPAA compliant environments.

text: Lets you control which events are saved and counted toward your event quota
quote: Take control over which events we save and count towards your event quota.

text: Provides error reporting libraries for over 50 platforms
quote: BugSnag provides error reporting libraries for over 50 different platforms, listed in the navigation to the left.

text: Lets you compare two performance span instances from the same group side by side
quote: Compare two span instances from the same span group side by side.

text: Lets you define custom session windows via SDK API and view aggregated CPU/memory metrics per session
quote: Create your own session windows using the SDK API and get aggregated cpu and memory metrics(mean, min,max) for each one.Session span groups are found under the new **Sessions** tab in Performance.

text: Monitors CPU, memory, and rendering performance (slow/frozen frames, FPS) for Flutter apps on Android/iOS
quote: Monitor CPU usage, memory consumption, and rendering performance (slow/frozen frames, FPS) directly from Flutter apps on Android and iOS.

text: Shows related events sharing the same user, device, session, or trace directly from the event view
quote: Instantly see related BugSnag events sharing the same user, device, session, or trace — right from the event view — to spot patterns and debug faster.

text: Self-hosted MCP server supports OAuth 2.0 browser-based login instead of manual API tokens
quote: Self Hosted MCP Server OAuth 2.0 support — securely connect to BugSnag via browser-based login instead of manual API tokens.

text: Provides a pre-main aggregate view to monitor iOS app startup time
quote: Pre-main aggregate view for iOS App Starts — monitor and optimize pre-main startup time at a glance.
